name: heremita
description: Heremita - plan your own trip: places on a map, day-by-day itinerary, routes and shared opinions.

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --recursive --parallel run dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --recursive run typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --recursive run lint && eslint eslint.config.mjs scripts
scripts.test: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --recursive --workspace-concurrency=1 run test
scripts.e2e: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @heremita/web run e2e
scripts.e2e:webkit: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @heremita/web run e2e:webkit
scripts.e2e:install: pnpm --filter @heremita/web exec playwright install chromium webkit
